name: Phonk Tower 🎶
desc:
🎶 Welcome to Phonk Troll Tower! 😈

🌀 Climb the Tower with Phonk and unlock Gears as you go! 
🎲 Gain a new Gear every 5 minutes!
🏆 Can you reach the top of the Troll Tower and claim the OP Gear and Admin?
😹 Use your gear to troll others, cause mayhem, or just survive the climb!

🎁 Like 👍 and Favorite ⭐ the game to unlock exclusive in-game rewards!
🚪 Join the group to access a secret teleport zone and more surprises!

✨ New Funk coming soon! 🎵
